fluency.band9: Context → consequence (“so”) → contrast (“but we still…”) → personal feeling.

lexical.band9: English-focused class, extra periods, cover the core subjects, a heavy workload.

grammar.band9: “still have to + verb”, and correct “be used to + noun” (I'm used to it by now).

vocabulary.example: Reading that article was a real lightbulb moment for me.

vocabulary.definition: worth the time, money or effort spent
vocabulary.example: Volunteering is tiring but worthwhile.

fluency.band6: Answers, then adds an unconnected second idea (“But friends are also important”).
fluency.band9: Acknowledges the difficulty (“That's a tough one”), states a choice, supports it with an example, then balances with “That said”.

lexical.band6: Collocation error: “teach us knowledge” (natural: “teach us”, “help us learn”).

vocabulary.definition: to cause something to either succeed or fail completely

vocabulary.definition: to ask someone questions to test their knowledge
vocabulary.example: My sister quizzed me on vocabulary before the test.

fluency.band6: Numbers, then a flat comment (“It is a lot of time”).
fluency.band9: Reaction → builds the total step by step (“School alone… then… on top of that”) → “All in all” summary → wider comment.

lexical.band9: way more than I'd like, extra classes, all in all, par for the course, under pressure.

grammar.band9: “alone” for emphasis (School alone is…), infinitive after “pressure” (under pressure to get into…).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 9 starts with an emotional reaction, adds up the time step by step, then places the answer in a wider context.

vocabulary.definition: (informal) much more than

vocabulary.definition: considering everything; in total
vocabulary.example: All in all, it was a successful year.

vocabulary.definition: normal and expected in a particular situation
vocabulary.example: Long queues are par for the course at Tết.

vocabulary.definition: feeling that you must do something because others expect it
vocabulary.example: Many students are under pressure to score highly.

fluency.band9: Firm answer, reason, what I do because of it (“so that's when…”), then contrast (“After lunch…”).

vocabulary.definition: to be fully understood or remembered
vocabulary.example: The news took a while to sink in.

fluency.band9: Shows development over time: “At first… over time… So…” leading to a conclusion.

lexical.band9: hooked on, without subtitles, opens a lot of doors, a no-brainer.

grammar.band6: Tense error: “I liked English since…” (correct: “I've liked English since…”).
